name: Natural sciences
characteristic: OECD FOS field: the science of the non-artefactual world
positive_test: the work's claim is about nature, number or computation as such
negative_test: a claim about an engineered artefact's performance (branch 2) or about a patient population (branch 3)
notes: OECD level 1, fixed.

name: Engineering & technology
characteristic: OECD FOS field: the design and operation of artefacts
positive_test: the work advances how a built system is designed, controlled or manufactured
negative_test: the artefact is the learning algorithm itself -> Method axis, not here
notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Robotics lives here (2.2), not as a top branch.

name: Medical & health sciences
characteristic: OECD FOS field: human health as the object of knowledge
positive_test: the knowledge advanced is about human health, disease, care or populations
negative_test: non-human biology -> 1.6; device engineering with no clinical claim -> 2.6
notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Largest branch in this corpus; that asymmetry is a finding, never engineered away. Top surfaces: Healthcare, Healthcare AI, Medical Research, Artificial Intelligence in Medicine.

name: Agricultural & veterinary sciences
characteristic: OECD FOS field: managed biological production systems
positive_test: the knowledge advanced concerns crops, livestock, forests, fisheries or animal health
negative_test: wild-organism biology -> 1.6 ecology/zoology; food retail -> Sector axis
notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Near-empty here; kept because it is OECD's and because agri-ML is large outside this institute.

name: Social sciences
characteristic: OECD FOS field: human behaviour, institutions and their study
positive_test: the knowledge advanced is about people, groups, markets, institutions or learning
negative_test: a demand made on an AI system (fairness, accountability) -> Desired properties axis
notes: OECD level 1, fixed.

name: Humanities
characteristic: OECD FOS field: interpretation of human culture and thought
positive_test: the knowledge advanced is about language, art, history, or philosophical argument
negative_test: language as a signal the model consumes -> Modality axis; NLP as machinery -> Method axis
notes: OECD level 1, fixed. Nearly empty in this corpus; reported, not balanced.

name: Uninformative
positive_test: the surface is on-axis but names no field at any granularity
negative_test: a name that says nothing about discipline at all is ABSENT from this axis, not uninformative (AXES.md 8b)
notes: Required by AXES.md 8b. Excluded from this axis's shares. Legitimately near-empty here, for the same reason as the properties axis (D-P4/D-P5): vague-but-on-axis surfaces are absorbed as branch-level surfaces on the field nodes.

name: Mathematics
positive_test: the paper's contribution is a mathematical or statistical result stated for its own field
negative_test: optimisation, game theory, information theory and learning theory supply machinery to ML and are Method (AXES.md 7)
notes: Thin by construction: this axis exports most maths-shaped names to Method.

name: Computer & information sciences
positive_test: the served field is a computing discipline that predates and survives machine learning
negative_test: core AI/ML/DL machinery is NOT here: it is Method, Modality or Task. See RATIONALE D1.
notes: OECD's own scope note places AI and bioinformatics inside 1.2; we deviate on both. Declared defect.

name: Physical sciences
characteristic: which physical system is under study
positive_test: the claim is about matter, energy, fields or astronomical objects
negative_test: physics used as an inductive bias (PINNs, physics-guided learning) is Method
notes: Full OECD L3 set kept: the institute has live astro/HEP collaborations and ML-for-fluids/optics is large outside it. Top surfaces: Physics, Physical Systems, Machine Learning for Physical Sciences, Deep Learning in Experimental Physics.

name: Chemical sciences
positive_test: the claim is about molecules, reactions or chemical matter
negative_test: a molecule as a data structure the model consumes -> Modality; therapeutic intent -> 3.1 pharmacology
notes: OECD's L3 (organic/inorganic/physical/analytical) does not accommodate computational chemistry; see RATIONALE D4.

name: Earth & related environmental sciences

positive_test: the claim is about the atmosphere, oceans, land surface or climate
negative_test: remote sensing as an instrument -> 2.7; energy markets -> Sector axis

positive_test: the claim is about living systems other than human health
negative_test: neuroscience is OECD 3.1, not here; human disease -> branch 3
